turn1.evidence: Nearly every top document involves boats or ships: SeaArk boats, power ships, a cruise-ship casino, Swedish listed ships, flying boats, V.Ships crew, cargo ships, a sunken rig, and the Stargate ship salvage, with even 'anchor' (anchor-electronics, anchor text) pulling in two examples. Yet activation sits on the commas and periods, and the nautical nouns themselves stay near 0.1–0.2.
